scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: .venv/bin/python -m ruff check api.py backend sync tests scripts/stage2_setup.py scripts/stage2_verify.py scripts/stage4_migrate.py scripts/stage8_cutover.py
scripts.format:check: .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check api.py backend sync tests scripts/stage2_setup.py scripts/stage2_verify.py scripts/stage4_migrate.py scripts/stage8_cutover.py
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run format:check
